name: ModelColumnName
description: An object representing the name of a column in the data model.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ModelColumnName object. Read-only.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: A String representing a table name of a table in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ColumnName
properties.description: A String representing the name of a column of the table identified by the TableName property. Read-only.
